fields.summary_ko.0: Eli Lilly (LLY) reported Q3 revenue of $2.44 billion, up 39% YoY, with EPS of $7.22, up 16%.
fields.summary_ko.1: A $10,000 investment split $5,000 each into LLY and NVO could see substantial growth through end-2027, though competitive intensification and other risks exist.
fields.summary_ko.2: Novo Nordisk's oral Wegovy generated approximately $796 million in Q3 revenue, driving growth.
